snippet.title: Rivalhearts Trailer
snippet.description:
A free visual novel about university life, love, and strife!
Play now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3232710/Rivalhearts/
Join Noah in his first year of university as he decides to overcome his heartache, pursuing either a tomboy classmate, cougar doctor, or junior-year goth! 

Out now in early access!

Rivalhearts Discord: https://discord.gg/S8V8xaJFJs
